description: Closed-loop sensorless FOC holding the same speed. Current is a result here, not a command: the speed loop supplies only the torque friction actually demands.
notes: Draws about 0.08 A against the forced legs' 0.50 A for the same speed — roughly 6x less current for the same mechanical job.
Its ripple percentage is NOT comparable to the 0.5 A legs: at 0.078 A the 0.020 A measurement noise floor is 26 % of the signal, so the figure is noise, not torque ripple.
title: Sensorless FOC (closed loop), 898 rad/s el
